name: Macau
title: LGBTQ rights in Macau
extract: Lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ) persons in Macau, face legal challenges not experienced by non-LGBTQ residents. While same-sex sexual activity was decriminalized in 1996, same-sex couples and households headed by same-sex couples remain ineligible for some legal rights available to opposite-sex couples.
